title: BIRA
subtitle: Energy bar made from surplus cherries
deck: Turning the surplus of the Basque cherry harvest into a natural energy bar for amateur cyclists.
role: Packaging structure, dielines and 3D visualisation of the bar, wrapper and display box.
team: Aimar Arauzo, Mikel Arnao, Jon Azpitarte, Ibai Esquivel, Manex Gonzalez

hero.caption: BIRA, cover of the project dossier.

sections.title: Context and brief
paragraphs: The Ereindajan cooperative needed an outlet for the summer surplus of Basque cherries. BIRA turns it into a functional bar of cherry, legumes, oats and nuts, aimed at amateur cycling.

sections.title: Research
paragraphs: Trends, a benchmark of energy bars, three interviews and a 90-person survey showed distrust of additives and ultra-processed food, a need for steady energy and interest in real fruit flavours. A positioning map placed BIRA between sports nutrition and real food.

sections.title: Concepts
paragraphs: Product, packaging and brand concepts were developed in parallel, following the DBZ methodology.

sections.title: Result
paragraphs: Brand, wrapper, display box and 5Ps, with the trademark and design protected through EUIPO. The work closed with a technical report, two A1 panels and a promotional video.
